text:
violet.design: quick copy check on the tooltip for the 'Keep warm' toggle in Dedicated Pools. Current tooltip reads: 'Keeps nodes warm to reduce cold starts.' a11y said it's ambiguous when read by screen readers.

ethan.pm: product nit: 'cold starts' is jargon for some customers. can we make it clearer about cost vs latency tradeoff?

sam.eng: implementation note: tooltip appears on hover and focus. For screen readers we need an accessible name and preferably additional context elsewhere. Also avoid long tooltip text; screen readers will read the whole thing.

violet.design: microcopy options:
- Short: 'Reduce cold starts'
- Clarified: 'Reduce cold starts (keeps nodes ready)'
- Explicit: 'Keep nodes warm to lower request latency; may increase cost'
Which balances clarity vs brevity?

ethan.pm: explicit wins for transparency. but visually I prefer 'Keep nodes warm' and show the cost hint in the control's help text.

aria-bot: A11Y guidance: tooltip text alone is not sufficient context for screen reader users. Use an adjacent aria-describedby on the toggle that points to a short paragraph explaining the tradeoffs. Tooltip can stay short for hover users. Also ensure the toggle has aria-pressed or role=switch depending on implementation.

sam.eng: we can add a hidden paragraph with id="keep-warm-desc" that reads: 'Keeping nodes warm reduces cold-start latency but increases running cost. Use for latency-sensitive routes.' and set aria-describedby on the toggle. Tooltip text will be 'Keep nodes warm'.

violet.design: updated plan: Visual tooltip: 'Keep nodes warm' Inline helper under toggle (visible): 'May increase cost; improves latency.' Offscreen detailed description id=keep-warm-desc for SR: full sentence from sam. I'll update the component token and Figma.

ethan.pm: please include the policy link in the detailed paragraph: '/docs/pooling#cost-vs-latency' so power users can read more.

aria-bot: checklist: toggle role, aria-describedby referencing visible or hidden text, tooltip short, detailed explanation available, test with VoiceOver/NVDA.

violet.design: thanks all 44d I'll push the Figma update and a small PR with the aria attributes.
